description:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * kernel: netlabel: Fix NULL pointer exception caused by CALIPSO on IPv4 sockets (CVE-2025-22063)
  * kernel: calipso: Don't call calipso functions for AF_INET sk. (CVE-2025-38147)
  * kernel: ALSA: hda/cs35l41: Fix firmware load work teardown (CVE-2026-64481)
  * kernel: ALSA: seq: close a re-opened queue timer in the destructor (CVE-2026-68202)
  * kernel: vmxnet3: fix BUG_ON in vmxnet3_get_hdr_len() for Geneve packets (CVE-2026-68299)
  * kernel: ovl: check access to copy_file_range source with src mounter creds (CVE-2026-68448)
  * kernel: xfs: fix exchange-range reflink flag clearing issue with INO1_WRITTEN (CVE-2026-80530)
  * kernel: xfs: bounds-check buffer log item's dirty bitmap (CVE-2026-80536)


Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):  

  * RTLA segfaults on freed memory access on double SIGINT [almalinux-9.8.z] (JIRA:AlmaLinux-193029)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
